title: VDOT++: Unified Few-Step Video Generation via Unbalanced Optimal Transport Distillation
title_zh: VDOT++：通过非平衡最优传输蒸馏实现统一的少步视频生成

paragraphs.en: Video creation spans text-to-video (T2V), image-to-video (I2V), and condition-based generation, yet modern video diffusion models remain costly because they repeatedly evaluate large backbones during sampling. Distribution matching distillation (DMD) reduces this cost, but its reverse Kullback–Leibler (KL) objective can provide unstable or incomplete guidance when the student and teacher distributions have limited overlap. A preliminary version of this work, VDOT (CVPR 2026), addressed this issue by adding optimal transport distillation (OTD), whose explicit coupling supplies geometric directions for condition-based generation. Balanced OTD, however, performs full-mass matching between the spatial tokens of each corresponding student–teacher frame pair. This assumption weakens for T2V and I2V, where one condition admits many valid outputs and spatial content need not align across different realizations. We present VDOT ++ , a unified distillation framework that applies the same training recipe separately to task-specific generators for the three task families. It makes OTD robust to output diversity through an asymmetric unbalanced formulation that allows unreliable student tokens to carry less mass while maintaining coverage of the teacher tokens. An ℓ 1 \ell_{1} ground cost further replaces mean-based aggregation with a more mode-preserving, coordinate-wise weighted median that limits the influence of distant transport targets. The two changes respectively determine whom to match and how the selected targets should be aggregated. We additionally combine distribution matching and adversarial refinement through sequential backward passes, and exploit the decoupled score networks for cross-scale distillation, where larger auxiliary score networks improve a compact generator. A scalable multi-task data pipeline and the UVCBench benchmark support evaluation across heterogeneous conditions. Experiments on UVCBench , VBench, VBench-I2V, and the VACE benchmark show that the resulting four-step generators are competitive with many-step teachers and strong few-step baselines across all three task families.
paragraphs.zh: 视频生成涵盖文本到视频（T2V）、图像到视频（I2V）以及基于条件的生成，但现代视频扩散模型仍然成本高昂，因为在采样过程中需要反复评估大型骨干网络。 分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）可以降低这种成本，但当学生和教师分布的重叠有限时，其反向库尔贝克-莱布勒（KL）目标可能会提供不稳定或不完整的指导。 这项工作的初步版本 VDOT（CVPR 2026）通过添加最优传输蒸馏（OTD）解决了这个问题，其显式耦合为基于条件的生成提供了几何方向。 然而，平衡 OTD 会在每个对应的学生-教师帧对的空间标记之间执行全质量匹配。 对于 T2V 和 I2V，这一假设会减弱，因为一个条件可以产生许多有效输出，且不同实现中的空间内容不必一致。 我们提出了 VDOT++，一个统一的蒸馏框架，它将相同的训练方案分别应用于三个任务族中特定任务的生成器。 通过一种非对称的不平衡公式，它使 OTD 对输出多样性具有鲁棒性：该公式允许不可靠的学生标记携带较少质量，同时保持对教师标记的覆盖。 一个 ℓ₁ \ell_{1} 地面成本进一步用更保留模式、按坐标加权的中间值取代了基于均值的聚合，从而限制了遥远传输目标的影响。 这两项改动分别决定了匹配对象以及所选目标应如何被聚合。 我们还通过顺序反向传播将分布匹配和对抗性优化相结合，并利用解耦的得分网络进行跨尺度蒸馏，其中较大的辅助得分网络可以改进紧凑的生成器。 一个可扩展的多任务数据管道和 UVCBench 基准支持在异构条件下进行评估。 在 UVCBench、VBench、VBench-I2V 和 VACE 基准上的实验表明，由此产生的四步生成器在所有三个任务族中都能与多步教师模型和强大的少步基线模型相媲美。

paragraphs.en: Video creation spans generation and editing from text, reference images, source videos, and spatial masks. Unified models such as VACE [ 1 ] and UNIC [ 2 ] support these conditions within a shared architecture, but their large diffusion backbones still require many denoising evaluations. Few-step distillation can reduce this cost, yet its supervision must remain reliable across tasks with very different degrees of output ambiguity.
paragraphs.zh: 视频创作涵盖了从文本、参考图像、源视频和空间掩码出发的生成与编辑。 VACE [ 1 ] 和 UNIC [ 2 ] 等统一模型在共享架构内支持这些条件，但其大型扩散主干网络仍然需要大量的去噪评估。 少步蒸馏可以降低这一成本，但其在输出模糊性程度差异极大的不同任务中，监督机制仍需保持可靠。

paragraphs.en: Distribution matching distillation (DMD) [ 3 , 4 ] uses an approximate reverse-KL gradient to align a few-step student with a many-step teacher. When their distributions overlap poorly, this signal may miss teacher modes or become unstable on unsupported student samples. Our conference method, VDOT [ 5 ] , supplements DMD with optimal transport distillation (OTD), whose explicit coupling supplies geometric directions for condition-based generation.
paragraphs.zh: 分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）[ 3 , 4 ] 使用近似的反向 KL 梯度，使少数步学生模型与多数步教师模型对齐。 当它们的分布重叠不佳时，这种信号可能会遗漏教师模型的模式，或在学生模型不支持的样本上变得不稳定。 我们的会议方法 VDOT [ 5 ] 通过最优传输蒸馏（OTD）对 DMD 进行补充，其显式耦合为基于条件的生成提供了几何方向。

paragraphs.en: Balanced OTD, however, solves a full-mass spatial-token matching problem independently within each corresponding student–teacher frame pair. Dense conditions such as depth or pose make these within-frame correspondences reliable, whereas T2V and single-frame I2V admit many valid appearances and motions. In the latter regime, hard marginals force every student token to carry prescribed mass even when no reliable teacher match exists ( whom to match ), while the squared- ℓ 2 \ell_{2} cost induces mean-based aggregation over potentially incompatible teacher tokens ( how to aggregate ). The challenge is to retain geometric guidance without treating diversity among valid outputs as error.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，平衡的 OTD 会在每个对应的学生-教师帧对内部独立地解决一个全质量的空间标记匹配问题。 深度或姿态等密集条件使这些帧内对应关系具有可靠性，而 T2V 和单帧 I2V 则允许许多有效的外观和运动。 在后一种情况下，硬性边缘概率迫使每个学生标记都必须携带预设的质量，即使不存在可靠的教师匹配对象（与谁匹配），而平方 ℓ₂ 成本则会促使对可能不兼容的教师标记进行基于均值的聚合（如何聚合）。 挑战在于保留几何引导，同时不把有效输出之间的多样性视为错误。

paragraphs.en: VDOT ++ addresses the two failure modes with asymmetric unbalanced OT and an ℓ 1 \ell_{1} ground cost. A relaxed student marginal downweights unreliable student tokens, while a strongly constrained teacher marginal maintains coverage of the teacher tokens. The ℓ 1 \ell_{1} cost replaces mean-based aggregation with a coordinate-wise weighted median that is less sensitive to distant targets. We further combine distribution matching and adversarial refinement through memory-efficient sequential backward passes, and use larger auxiliary score networks during distillation to strengthen a compact generator. Our evaluation covers single and composite condition-based tasks from UVCBench , as well as established benchmarks for T2V and I2V.
paragraphs.zh: VDOT ++ 通过非对称不平衡 OT 和 ℓ₁ \ell_{1} 地面成本来解决这两种失效模式。 放松的学生边际会降低不可靠学生标记的权重，而强约束的教师边际则保持对教师标记的覆盖。 ℓ₁ \ell_{1} 成本用按坐标加权的中间值取代了基于均值的聚合方法，这种中间值对遥远目标不那么敏感。 我们通过内存高效的顺序反向传播进一步结合了分布匹配和对抗性优化，并在蒸馏过程中使用更大的辅助得分网络来增强紧凑的生成器。 我们的评估涵盖了来自 UVCBench 的单条件和复合条件任务，以及 T2V 和 I2V 的成熟基准测试。

paragraphs.en: Experiments reveal a consistent conditioning-dependent pattern: the relaxed objective behaves similarly to balanced OTD when dense inputs establish reliable correspondences, but better preserves valid motion and detail as the admissible output space widens. Controlled ablations isolate matching, cost, relaxation direction, adversarial refinement, and score-network scale.
paragraphs.zh: 实验揭示了一种稳定的、依赖于条件设置的规律：当密集输入建立了可靠的对应关系时，松弛目标函数与平衡 OTD 的行为相似；但随着可接受输出空间扩大，它能更好地保留有效运动和细节。 受控的消融研究分别隔离了匹配、成本、松弛方向、对抗性优化以及评分网络规模等因素的影响。

paragraphs.en: We extend VDOT from condition-based video creation to T2V and I2V, establishing a unified few-step distillation framework across all three task families. When the student and teacher distributions overlap poorly, OTD complements DMD’s potentially unreliable score-difference gradients by constructing explicit token-level transport plans between their outputs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 VDOT 从基于条件的视频生成扩展到 T2V 和 I2V，从而在所有三个任务系列中建立了一个统一的少步蒸馏框架。 当学生和教师的分布重叠不佳时，OTD 通过在它们输出之间构建明确的词元级传输计划，来补充 DMD 可能不可靠的分数差异梯度。

sents.en: We extend VDOT from condition-based video creation to T2V and I2V, establishing a unified few-step distillation framework across all three task families.
sents.zh: 我们将 VDOT 从基于条件的视频生成扩展到 T2V 和 I2V，从而在所有三个任务系列中建立了一个统一的少步蒸馏框架。

sents.en: When the student and teacher distributions overlap poorly, OTD complements DMD’s potentially unreliable score-difference gradients by constructing explicit token-level transport plans between their outputs.
sents.zh: 当学生和教师的分布重叠不佳时，OTD 通过在它们输出之间构建明确的词元级传输计划，来补充 DMD 可能不可靠的分数差异梯度。

paragraphs.en: We identify forced correspondence and mean-based aggregation as two distinct failures of balanced, squared-cost OTD under output diversity, and replace it with asymmetric unbalanced transport and an ℓ 1 \ell_{1} ground cost. The former addresses whom to match by relaxing unreliable student-token mass while preserving teacher-token coverage; the latter addresses how to aggregate by limiting averaging across incompatible targets. Controlled ablations validate their complementary roles across conditioning strengths.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将强制对应和基于均值的聚合视为在输出多样性条件下，平衡平方成本 OTD 的两种不同失效模式，并用非对称不平衡传输和 ℓ₁ \ell_{1} 地面成本取而代之。 前者通过放宽不可靠的学生词元质量，同时保留教师词元的覆盖范围，来解决匹配对象的问题；后者则通过限制在不兼容目标之间进行平均，来解决如何聚合的问题。 受控的消融实验验证了它们在不同条件强度下相互补充的作用。

paragraphs.en: We introduce a scalable training design that combines distribution matching and adversarial refinement through sequential backward passes, accumulating a joint update within the memory budget of large video backbones. We further exploit the decoupling between the generator and score networks for cross-scale distillation, using larger auxiliary score networks to provide stronger supervision and improve the generation quality of a compact generator.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种可扩展的训练设计，通过顺序反向传播将分布匹配与对抗性优化相结合，在大型视频骨干网络的内存预算内累积联合更新。 我们进一步利用生成器与评分网络之间的解耦特性进行跨尺度蒸馏，使用更大的辅助评分网络提供更强的监督，并提升紧凑型生成器的生成质量。

sents.en: We introduce a scalable training design that combines distribution matching and adversarial refinement through sequential backward passes, accumulating a joint update within the memory budget of large video backbones.

paragraphs.en: Unified generative models encode heterogeneous controls through a shared conditioning interface. Image methods attach reusable control branches or unify generation and editing within one architecture [ 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 ] . Recent video systems extend this idea across multiple creation tasks. VACE [ 1 ] represents text, images, videos, and masks as aligned context frames and masks, whereas UNIC [ 2 ] maps heterogeneous inputs into shared token categories. Because these methods build on large diffusion backbones [ 12 , 13 ] , they retain the cost of iterative sampling. Our focus is complementary: rather than designing a unified backbone, we develop a unified distillation framework that accelerates pretrained models for VACE-style controllable creation, T2V, and I2V.
paragraphs.zh: 统一生成模型通过共享的条件接口对异构控制进行编码。 图像方法通过附加可重用的控制分支，或在单一架构内统一生成与编辑来实现这一点 [ 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 ] 。 近期的视频系统将这一理念扩展到了多种创作任务中。 VACE [ 1 ] 将文本、图像、视频和掩码表示为对齐的上下文帧和掩码，而 UNIC [ 2 ] 则将异构输入映射到共享的标记类别中。 由于这些方法基于大型扩散模型主干网络 [ 12 , 13 ] ，因此它们仍然需要承担迭代采样的成本。 我们的研究重点与之互补：我们并非设计一个统一的主干网络，而是开发了一个统一的蒸馏框架，用于加速预训练模型在 VACE 风格的可控创作、T2V 和 I2V 任务中的表现。

paragraphs.en: Video diffusion acceleration has been explored through model pruning [ 14 , 15 , 16 ] , quantization [ 17 , 18 , 19 ] , sparse attention [ 20 , 21 , 22 , 23 ] , feature caching [ 24 , 25 , 26 ] , and efficient sampling [ 3 , 4 , 27 ] . Among sampling acceleration approaches, few-step distillation trains a student to approximate many-step generation with a small number of denoising steps. Few-step diffusion distillation spans three relevant families. Consistency distillation compresses the teacher trajectory or enforces consistent predictions along it [ 28 , 29 ] . rCM further scales continuous-time consistency training to large image and video models by introducing score regularization [ 30 ] . Distribution matching instead aligns the student and teacher output distributions. DMD and DMD2 estimate a reverse-KL gradient using teacher and fake score networks [ 3 , 4 ] ; CausVid, Self-Forcing, and Salt adapt distribution-level training to autoregressive video generation [ 31 , 32 , 33 ] , while TDM matches few-step transition trajectories [ 34 ] . Adversarial distillation uses discriminators and real or teacher-synthesized data to restore perceptual detail, as in ADD, APT, ADP, and AccVideo [ 35 , 36 , 37 , 38 ] . Among these objectives, DMD provides distribution-level supervision through score differences, but this signal can become unreliable when student samples lie far from the teacher distribution. Our conference method, VDOT [ 5 ] , complements DMD with a token-level OT coupling, providing geometric guidance even under poor distribution overlap. The present work further revisits its marginal constraints and ground cost for tasks with different degrees of output ambiguity.

paragraphs.en: Optimal transport (OT) compares distributions through both a ground cost and an explicit transport plan [ 39 ] , with entropic regularization enabling efficient Sinkhorn optimization [ 40 ] . Transport geometry has supported generative modeling [ 41 , 42 , 43 , 44 ] , assignment [ 45 , 46 , 47 ] , and one-step image editing [ 48 ] . Balanced OT requires all mass to participate. Partial OT can leave costly mass unmatched [ 49 ] , whereas unbalanced OT replaces hard marginal equalities with divergence penalties [ 50 , 51 ] . Although UOT permits distinct penalties for the two marginals, generic distribution alignment does not determine which side should be relaxed more. Distillation supplies this directionality: the evolving student may contain unreliable tokens, whereas the fixed teacher remains the coverage target. This asymmetry motivates different marginal penalties, while an ℓ 1 \ell_{1} ground cost limits averaging over incompatible teacher tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 最优传输（OT）通过地面成本和一个显式的传输计划来比较分布 [39]，而熵正则化则使得高效的辛克霍恩优化成为可能 [40]。 传输几何学为生成式建模 [41, 42, 43, 44]、分配问题 [45, 46, 47] 以及单步图像编辑 [48] 提供了支持。 平衡最优传输要求所有质量都必须参与。 部分最优传输可能会使代价高昂的质量无法匹配 [49]，而不平衡最优传输则用发散惩罚项取代了严格的边缘分布等式约束 [50, 51]。 尽管非平衡最优传输允许对两个边缘分布施加不同的惩罚，但一般的分布对齐方法并未确定哪一侧应被更多地放宽。 蒸馏提供了这种方向性：不断演化的学生模型可能包含不可靠的标记，而固定的教师模型仍然是覆盖的目标。 这种不对称性促使我们采用不同的边缘惩罚项，同时 ℓ₁ 地面成本可以限制对不兼容的教师模型标记进行平均。

paragraphs.en: Both Eqs. ( 4 ) and ( 5 ) are balanced : their hard marginal constraints require all mass on both sides to participate. Partial OT [ 49 ] instead transports only a prescribed fraction κ POT ∈ ( 0 , 1 ] \kappa_{\mathrm{POT}}\in(0,1] of the mass and leaves costly correspondences unmatched. Unbalanced OT [ 50 ] achieves a related relaxation by replacing the marginal equalities with divergence penalties, so that mass may deviate from the prescribed marginals where matching is unreliable. Balanced OT is recovered when all mass participates in partial OT ( κ POT = 1 \kappa_{\mathrm{POT}}=1 ) or when the unbalanced marginal penalties become arbitrarily strong. Together, these formulations separate the coupling constraints from the choice of ground cost. Section IV specializes both components for OTD across different conditioning strengths.
paragraphs.zh: 方程 (4) 和 (5) 都是平衡的：其严格的边际约束要求两侧的所有质量都必须参与。而部分最优传输（Partial OT）[49] 则仅传输预定比例 κ POT ∈ (0,1] 的质量，并留下高成本的对应关系未匹配。非平衡最优传输（Unbalanced OT）[50] 通过将边际等式替换为散度惩罚项来实现一种相关的松弛，从而使得在匹配不可靠时，质量可以偏离预定的边际分布。当所有质量都参与部分最优传输（κ POT = 1）或当非平衡的边际惩罚变得极强时，即可恢复平衡最优传输。这些公式共同将耦合约束与基础成本的选择区分开来。第 IV 节针对不同强度的条件约束，对最优传输距离（OTD）的这两个组成部分进行了专门讨论。

paragraphs.en: VDOT ++ distills a pretrained many-step video diffusion model into a few-step generator using a shared training objective across task-specific conditioning interfaces. We instantiate it with VACE-Wan2.1-14B [ 1 ] for condition-based generation and Wan2.1-14B [ 13 ] for T2V and I2V. As in DMD, a frozen teacher score network F ψ F_{\psi} and a trainable fake-score network F ϕ F_{\phi} guide the generator G θ G_{\theta} . The conference version introduced balanced OTD to supplement the reverse-KL signal with explicit geometric correspondences [ 5 ] . We extend that formulation in three respects: partial matching avoids forcing unreliable correspondences, asymmetric marginal penalties preserve the distinct roles of student and teacher, and an ℓ 1 \ell_{1} ground cost makes aggregation robust to diverse targets. A lightweight adversarial head further corrects local appearance errors. These losses are accumulated through sequential backward passes and applied in a single generator update. Figure 3 summarizes the framework; the remainder of this section develops each component and the resulting training procedure.
paragraphs.zh: VDOT ++ 通过跨任务特定条件接口的共享训练目标，将预训练的长步数视频扩散模型蒸馏为短步数生成器。 我们使用 VACE-Wan2.1-14B [ 1 ] 实现基于条件的生成，并使用 Wan2.1-14B [ 13 ] 实现 T2V 和 I2V 生成。 与 DMD 类似，一个冻结的教师得分网络 F ψ F_{\psi} 和一个可训练的虚假得分网络 F ϕ F_{\phi} 指导生成器 G θ G_{\theta}。 会议版本引入了平衡 OTD，以通过显式的几何对应关系补充反向 KL 信号 [ 5 ]。 我们在三个方面扩展了该公式：部分匹配可避免强制使用不可靠的对应关系，非对称边缘惩罚保留了学生和教师的不同角色，而 ℓ 1 \ell_{1} 地面成本则使聚合过程对多样化的目标更具鲁棒性。 一个轻量级的对抗性头进一步修正了局部外观错误。 这些损失通过顺序的后向传播累积，并在单次生成器更新中应用。 图 3 总结了该框架；本节其余部分将详细阐述每个组件以及由此产生的训练流程。

paragraphs.en: Why the median is robust under diversity. For a fixed plan, the weighted mean is sensitive to the magnitude of distant targets, so a small amount of transported mass can exert a disproportionately large pull. The coordinate-wise weighted median instead depends on how mass is ordered around each coordinate and has bounded sensitivity to target magnitude. When most transported mass forms a coherent cluster, the median remains governed by that cluster rather than being displaced toward an extreme target. The ℓ 1 \ell_{1} cost thus reduces averaging across incompatible content, complementing partial matching: the latter reduces the influence of unreliable pairs, while the former limits the influence of diverse targets that remain in the plan.
paragraphs.zh: 为何中位数在多样性条件下仍具有稳健性。 对于一个固定的计划，加权平均值对遥远目标的量级非常敏感，因此少量运输的质量可能产生不成比例的巨大拉力。 相比之下，按坐标计算的加权中位数取决于质量在每个坐标周围的排序方式，并且对目标量级的敏感度有限。 当大部分运输的质量形成一个连贯的簇时，中位数仍由该簇决定，而不会向极端目标偏移。 因此，ℓ₁ \ell_{1} 成本减少了在不兼容内容之间的平均操作，从而补充了部分匹配：后者降低了不可靠配对的影响，而前者则限制了计划中保留的多样化目标所带来的影响。

paragraphs.en: Fused updates under memory constraints. At the 14B scale, we avoid retaining two live computation graphs by backpropagating the distillation loss, freeing its graph, and then re-running the same sample for the adversarial loss on scheduled adversarial updates. The two gradients accumulate before one optimizer step, preserving the joint objective with the peak memory of a single backward pass. The critic is handled analogously. This gradient-fused schedule replaces the alternating updates of the conference version [ 5 ] and is ablated in Sec. V-C .
paragraphs.zh: 在内存限制下融合更新。 在 14B 规模上，我们通过反向传播蒸馏损失来避免保留两个活跃的计算图，从而释放其计算图，然后在计划好的对抗性更新中重新运行相同样本以计算对抗性损失。 两个梯度在一次优化器步骤前进行累积，从而保留了联合目标函数，同时峰值内存仅相当于单次反向传播。 批评者的处理方式类似。 这种梯度融合的计划方案取代了会议版本 [ 5 ] 中的交替更新，并在第 V-C 节中进行了消融分析。

paragraphs.en: Training setup. We distill VACE-Wan2.1-14B [ 1 ] , Wan2.1-T2V-14B, and Wan2.1-I2V-14B [ 13 ] into four-step generators with one recipe. paragraphs.en: With four denoising steps, VDOT ++ remains competitive with its many-step teachers across all three task families. As conditioning weakens, its gains concentrate on motion and imaging quality while temporal and subject consistency remain stable. This task-dependent profile matches the motivation for relaxing only unreliable correspondences.
paragraphs.zh: 在四个去噪步骤中，VDOT++ 在所有三个任务类别中仍能与多步骤的模型相媲美。 随着条件约束减弱，其优势主要集中在运动和成像质量上，而时间和主体一致性则保持稳定。 这种依赖具体任务的特性与仅放宽不可靠对应关系的动机相符。

paragraphs.en: Unified evaluation on UVCBench . Table II shows that VDOT ++ remains close to VDOT on the dense pose, flow, and greyscale conditions, but improves the normalized average on outpainting and R2V. In the latter tasks, observed content provides an anchor while partial matching leaves unspecified regions and frames flexible. The full results in Appendix E show a task-dependent balance between appearance and dynamics: increased motion can accompany lower imaging quality, with lower normalized averages on several dense and composite tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 在 UVCBench 上的统一评估。 表 II 显示，在密集姿态、光流和灰度条件下，VDOT++ 的性能与 VDOT 接近，但在图像外推和 R2V 任务上提升了归一化平均值。 在后一类任务中，观察到的内容提供了锚点，而部分匹配则使未指定的区域和帧保持灵活。 附录 E 中的完整结果表明，外观与动态性之间的平衡因任务而异：运动增强可能伴随成像质量下降，导致多个密集和复合任务的归一化平均值降低。

paragraphs.en: Text-to-video generation. On T2V (Table III ), VDOT ++ improves motion and imaging quality while maintaining consistency, producing the best normalized average among both few-step baselines and the many-step teacher. This agrees with the method design: a text prompt fixes semantics but not trajectory, so partial matching preserves plausible motion and the ℓ 1 \ell_{1} cost avoids averaging distinct futures. Figure 5 shows clear motion without distorting the locomotive or viaduct. Fine steam and snow details also remain stable.
paragraphs.zh: 文本到视频生成。 在 T2V（表 III）中，VDOT++ 在保持一致性的同时提升了运动和成像质量，在少步基线模型和多步教师模型中均实现了最佳的归一化平均值。 这与该方法的设计相符：文本提示固定了语义但未固定轨迹，因此部分匹配能够保留合理的运动，而 ℓ₁ 成本则避免了将不同的未来状态进行平均。 图 5 展示了清晰的运动效果，且未对机车或高架桥造成失真。 精细的蒸汽和雪花细节也保持稳定。

paragraphs.en: Image-to-video generation. I2V follows the same pattern (Table IV ): the first frame anchors appearance but not future motion, making partial matching preferable to copying one arbitrary continuation. VDOT ++ exceeds the teacher and other few-step methods in normalized average, with the largest gain appearing in motion rather than static appearance preservation. paragraphs.en: Controlled factorial: matching × \times cost × \times condition strength. On T2V, partial matching removes unreliable pairs, while ℓ 1 \ell_{1} avoids averaging distinct modes; either change improves over balanced ℓ 2 \ell_{2} , and their combination is strongest. The contrast across task families supports the two-pathology diagnosis: the proposed changes matter most when the condition admits diverse valid outputs rather than acting as a uniform regularizer.

paragraphs.en: Figure 7 illustrates the complementary effects in a surfing example. paragraphs.en: Asymmetric vs. symmetric relaxation. Table VI compares balanced, symmetric, and opposite assignments of the two marginal penalties. Source-side relaxation lets unreliable student tokens carry reduced mass while retaining teacher-token coverage, yielding the highest Dynamic Degree and normalized average. Its Imaging Quality (72.83) remains close to the best value of 72.95 under symmetric relaxation. Symmetric and target-side relaxation instead underweight difficult teacher tokens. Their lower averages, including the degradation from symmetric relaxation relative to balanced OT, show that relaxing both marginals is not sufficient; the direction of relaxation matters.
paragraphs.zh: 非对称松弛与对称松弛。 表 VI 比较了两种边际惩罚的平衡、对称和相反分配。 源端松弛允许不可靠的学生令牌携带减少的质量，同时保留教师令牌的覆盖范围，从而获得最高的动态度和归一化平均值。 其成像质量（72.83）仍接近对称松弛下的最佳值 72.95。 而对称和目标端松弛则会低估困难的教师令牌。 它们的平均值较低，包括对称松弛相对于平衡 OT 的下降，表明同时放松两个边际是不够的；松弛的方向也很重要。

paragraphs.en: This paper extends few-step OTD across T2V, I2V, and condition-based video creation by accounting for their different output ambiguity. VDOT ++ uses asymmetric unbalanced transport to suppress unreliable student correspondences while retaining teacher coverage, and an ℓ 1 \ell_{1} cost to avoid mean-based aggregation of incompatible targets. Experiments and controlled ablations support this conditioning-dependent design: it behaves similarly to balanced OTD under dense control, but better preserves valid motion and detail as the output space widens. Joint adversarial refinement improves local appearance, while cross-scale distillation uses larger auxiliary score networks to strengthen a compact generator.
paragraphs.zh: 本文通过考虑不同输出模态的模糊性差异，将少步 OTD 方法扩展到了 T2V、I2V 和基于条件的视频生成任务中。 VDOT ++ 采用非对称不平衡传输来抑制不可靠的学生对应关系，同时保留教师的覆盖范围，并利用 ℓ₁ 成本避免对不兼容目标进行均值聚合。 实验和受控消融研究支持这种依赖条件的设计：在密集控制下，其行为与平衡 OTD 类似；但随着输出空间扩大，它能更好地保留有效运动和细节。 联合对抗性优化可提升局部外观表现，而跨尺度蒸馏则利用更大的辅助得分网络来增强紧凑的生成器。

paragraphs.en: Limitations and future work. The current method solves spatial-token OT independently within corresponding temporal-frame pairs. It therefore models fine spatial correspondence but does not transport tokens across frames or jointly optimize a spatiotemporal plan. Spatiotemporal or trajectory-aware transport could capture motion-level correspondence, while adaptive marginal penalties could tune relaxation from condition strength or transport confidence. Extending the current four-step bidirectional setting to one-step, streaming, or autoregressive generation also requires handling stronger rollout errors and support mismatch.
paragraphs.zh: 局限性与未来工作。 当前方法在对应的时帧对内独立解决空间标记的 OT 问题。 因此，该方法虽然能建模精细的空间对应关系，但无法跨帧传输标记或联合优化时空规划。 时空感知或轨迹感知的传输方式能够捕捉运动层面的对应关系，而自适应边际惩罚则可根据条件强度或传输置信度调整松弛程度。 将当前的四步双向设置扩展为一步式、流式或自回归生成模式，还需要处理更严重的展开错误和支撑不匹配问题。

paragraphs.en: We follow the automated data and benchmark construction pipeline introduced in our conference version [ 5 ] ; the details required to reproduce the training corpus and UVCBench are summarized below.
paragraphs.zh: 我们遵循在会议版本 [ 5 ] 中介绍的自动化数据和基准构建流程；用于复现训练语料和 UVCBench 所需的细节总结如下。

paragraphs.en: Training data. We collect 250 000 4K Artgrid videos [ 71 ] , rescale them to 832 × 480 832\times 480 , and caption them with InternVL [ 72 ] . Captions serve as both prompts and filtering criteria. We express the first frame for I2V and automatically extracted depth, pose, optical flow, scribble, and mask signals for VACE-style tasks in the shared condition format. For pose, for example, Qwen3 [ 73 ] filters captions without human subjects; extracted pose sequences are ranked by weighted inter-frame keypoint displacement, and the highest-ranked samples are retained. Analogous curation is applied to each condition type.
paragraphs.zh: 训练数据。 我们收集了 250,000 个 4K Artgrid 视频 [71]，将其重新缩放为 832×480 [832\times 480]，并使用 InternVL [72] 为其添加字幕。 字幕既用作提示，也用作筛选标准。 对于 I2V 任务，我们将第一帧以共享条件格式表示；对于 VACE 风格的任务，则使用自动提取的深度、姿态、光流、草图和掩码信号。 例如，在姿态方面，Qwen3 [73] 会过滤掉不包含人类主体的字幕；提取的序列姿态根据加权帧间关键点位移进行排序，并保留排名最高的样本。 对每种条件类型都采用类似的筛选方法。

paragraphs.en: Benchmark construction. UVCBench contains 8 single-condition and 10 composite tasks, with 20 videos per task. Single-condition tasks cover pose, depth, optical flow, greyscale, scribble, face/object reference, canvas outpainting, and temporal extension. Composite tasks pair a reference image or first frame with pose, depth, flow, greyscale, or scribble. Qwen3-Max expands task descriptions into candidate prompts; Wan2.1-14B synthesizes V2V/MV2V exemplars, while VACE-14B uses Qwen-Image [ 74 ] references for R2V and composite tasks. The corresponding inputs and masks are derived automatically, then manually verified and regenerated when necessary.
paragraphs.zh: 基准构建。 UVCBench 包含 8 个单条件任务和 10 个组合任务，每个任务包含 20 个视频。 单条件任务涵盖姿态、深度、光流、灰度、草图、人脸/物体参考、画布外扩和时序扩展。 组合任务将参考图像或第一帧与姿态、深度、光流、灰度或草图进行配对。 Qwen3-Max 将任务描述扩展为候选提示；Wan2.1-14B 合成 V2V/MV2V 示例，而 VACE-14B 则使用 Qwen-Image [ 74 ] 参考用于 R2V 和组合任务。 相应的输入和掩码被自动生成，然后在必要时进行人工验证并重新生成。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation protocol. Generated videos on UVCBench are scored using six VBench dimensions: Aesthetic Quality, Background Consistency, Dynamic Degree, Imaging Quality, Motion Smoothness, and Subject Consistency. We additionally report their normalized average as a compact overall measure while retaining the individual dimensions to expose quality–motion trade-offs.
paragraphs.zh: 评估协议。 UVCBench 上生成的视频将使用 VBench 的六个维度进行评分：美学质量、背景一致性、动态程度、成像质量、运动流畅度和主体一致性。 我们还报告了它们的归一化平均值，作为简洁的整体衡量指标，同时保留各个维度，以揭示质量与运动之间的权衡关系。

paragraphs.en: Table XII reports the full per-task comparison on the VACE benchmark [ 1 ] , complementing the UVCBench results in Sec. V-B . Despite using only four NFEs, VDOT ++ remains competitive with the many-step VACE variants across the densely constrained depth, pose, flow, scribble, and greyscale tasks. The differences become more pronounced on extension, outpainting, and R2V, where the inputs specify only part of the target video. On these tasks, the stronger normalized averages are driven mainly by increased dynamics while the consistency metrics remain high. This pattern supports the intended role of the relaxed student marginal: uncertain regions need not be forced into arbitrary matches, allowing plausible content and motion to develop around the observed evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 表 XII 报告了 VACE 基准测试 [1] 中各项任务的完整对比结果，补充了第 V-B 节中的 UVCBench 结果。 尽管仅使用了四次 NFE，VDOT++ 在深度、姿态、流、草图和灰度等具有密集约束的任务中，仍能与多步 VACE 变体保持竞争力。 在扩展、外绘画和 R2V 任务中，差异变得更加显著，因为这些任务的输入仅指定了目标视频的一部分。 在这些任务中，更强的归一化平均值主要由动态性的增强所驱动，而一致性指标仍然保持在较高水平。 这一模式支持了放宽学生边际分布的初衷：不确定区域不必被强行匹配到任意内容，从而允许在观测证据周围生成合理的内容和运动。
